Additionally, 3-Hydroxymollugin is linked to the DNMT3A2/3L complex, which targets Curguligine B, which also targets the Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B3. These findings indicate that 3-Hydroxymollugin may exert its effects through diverse molecular mechanisms, potentially influencing the function of the transporter family member 1B3. The evidence is supported by multiple high-scoring pathways, suggesting a complex network of interactions. However, the exact nature of the relationship and the precise mechanisms involved remain to be fully elucidated.
